## 3. 4-Tier Test Matrix Coverage & Verification Results

### Tier 1: Feature Coverage (Core Functional Capabilities)
- [x] **`test_ws_connection_and_telemetry_frame`**: Handshake on `/ws/realtime` succeeds and delivers initial `telemetry_frame` packet with all primary keys.
- [x] **`test_telemetry_frame_schema_contract`**: Root JSON schema conformance (`type`, `timestamp`, `icebergs`, `vessels`, `telemetry`).
- [x] **`test_dynamic_icebergs_schema_and_projection`**: Icebergs array contains all 4 tracked tabular bergs (`C-19`, `B-15K`, `D-28`, `A-68R`) with dimensions, draft, velocity, and 6-hour projection vector.
- [x] **`test_ais_fallback_fleet_when_no_api_key`**: Automatic fallback polar fleet providing 6 authentic vessels (`RV Polarstern`, `Vasily Golovnin`, `SA Agulhas II`, `Xue Long 2`, `Akademik Fedorov`, `RRS Sir David Attenborough`).
- [x] **`test_rv_polar_explorer_telemetry_fields`**: Sounding depth, vessel design draft ($8.5\text{m}$), Under Keel Clearance ($\text{UKC} = \max(0.0, \text{depth} - 8.5)$), true wind, and corridor heading.
- [x] **`test_utc_timestamp_sgp4_synchronization`**: Millisecond-precision ISO-8601 UTC timestamp format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ`) for satellite SGP4 orbital propagation synchronization.

### Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases (Resilience & Invariants)
- [x] **`test_zero_payload_immediate_disconnect`**: Client immediate disconnection handled cleanly without leaking sockets or crashing background broadcast task.
- [x] **`test_rapid_connect_disconnect_churn`**: 5 consecutive rapid connect/disconnect cycles executed without starvation or state corruption.
- [x] **`test_multiple_concurrent_websocket_clients`**: 3 concurrent WebSocket clients receive broadcast frames simultaneously without dropped packets.
- [x] **`test_ukc_shallow_depth_non_negative_floor`**: Physical invariance check: $\text{UKC} = \max(0.0, \text{depth} - \text{draft}) \ge 0.0$ strictly maintained under all shallow depth conditions ($\le 8.5\text{m}$).
- [x] **`test_iceberg_and_vessel_geographic_bounds`**: All entity coordinates bounded within Southern Ocean waters ($-90.0^\circ \le \text{lat} \le -50.0^\circ$, $-180.0^\circ \le \text{lon} \le 180.0^\circ$).
- [x] **`test_heading_degrees_range_boundary`**: All headings and bearings strictly lie in interval $[0.0, 360.0)$.
- [x] **`test_client_unexpected_message_handling`**: Server safely handles unexpected client text messages without disconnecting or interrupting the broadcast stream.

### Tier 3: Cross-Feature Combinations (Dynamics & Cross-System Coupling)
- [x] **`test_iceberg_dynamic_drift_advancement`**: Dynamic coordinate advancement over consecutive frames $(lat_{t+1}, lon_{t+1}) \neq (lat_t, lon_t)$ with physical velocities.
- [x] **`test_6h_projection_vector_physics_consistency`**: 6-hour projection vector spans distance $\approx 6 \times speedKn$ nautical miles in the direction of drift heading.
- [x] **`test_telemetry_fairway_corridor_progression`**: RV Polar Explorer coordinates and heading advance along the Maitri-to-Bharati navigation corridor.
- [x] **`test_environmental_weather_telemetry_correlation`**: `trueWind` values correlate with Southern Ocean katabatic / easterlies wind profile from environmental lookup.
- [x] **`test_monotonic_timestamp_advancement`**: Timestamps across consecutive frames advance monotonically ($t_{n+1} \ge t_n$).

### Tier 4: Real-World Scenarios (End-to-End Operational Flows)
- [x] **`test_multi_second_voyage_stream_cadence`**: Continuous 4-frame reception over multiple seconds validating 1 Hz broadcast cadence, zero dropped fields, and stable entity counts.
- [x] **`test_tactical_hazard_closest_point_of_approach`**: Dynamic Closest Point of Approach (CPA) calculation between RV Polar Explorer and nearest iceberg hazard.
- [x] **`test_reconnection_simulation_exponential_backoff`**: Simulates client disconnect, backoff delay, and reconnection, verifying seamless stream recovery with advanced coordinates and timestamp.
- [x] **`test_dual_mode_cesium_entity_contract_readiness`**: Validates prerequisites for 3D Cesium rendering: unique stable IDs, numeric floats for `SampledPositionProperty` interpolation, ARPA leader stems (`PolylineArrowMaterialProperty`), and attributes for `disableDepthTestDistance: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY`.
